photo.credit: JAXA · IKAROS (Interplanetary Kite-craft Accelerated by Radiation Of the Sun) photographed by a separation camera during its Venus transit in 2010. IKAROS was the first spacecraft to demonstrate solar-sail propulsion in interplanetary space, deploying a 196 m² polyimide sail just 7.5 µm thick.

see_in_app.context_key: IKAROS (JAXA, 2010) — first interplanetary solar sail; LightSail 2 (Planetary Society, 2019) — first to raise orbit by sail alone
